_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "Also, if you are selling as a business, the business must be registered in the same country. Having a bank account based in another country will not, unfortunately, allow us to pay you out to that bank account unless you physically live (and can prove residence) in that country."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Gumroad Getting Paid help center (help.gumroad.com/article/13-getting-paid, undated, accessed April 2026) states business sellers must have their business registered in the same country as their bank account; a foreign bank account does not enable payout unless the seller can prove physical residence in that country
